[2026-10-27 22:29 CET] Finite recursive invocation coverage is published on formalize at 6b66b1b57f404658059422c2ac128828391d8e08 (four commits). NativeFiniteSiblingResources.alternatives_finite_complete_resources_accepting retains the entire original resource admission/result. An original accepted selected occurrence with support for its earlier prefix now yields its actual hook invocation OR an exact strictly earlier hook stop. The event includes its literal completed take-prefix/index/processed length, actual post-hook caller and full Memos, Packet/Fits/carrier/reservation, own completed captured receipt/local Post/cache/full Memos and whole-list Invocation. Chosen events construct a satisfying assignment extension and exact fragment filling. Earlier stops retain exact outputs/reason/optional endpoint, aggregate stopped result and stopped resources. A stopped chosen hook still counts as reached. One work bound is uniform; event witnesses may depend on extra/index/model.

parent_finite_complete_resources derives the accepted edge/index from the original stored parent model and selector permutation, derives finite Complete via the existing theorem, and retains the entire strengthened primary packet/observer. ALL-selected projection support is explicit. It does not imply whole scan or chosen-hook completion. No future invocation or callback success is supplied.
